messages.text: Plan my week. I have a job, the gym 3x, and a side project.
Happy to! One question first: when do you have the most energy?

Here's your week:
• 7–9am deep work on the side project
• 9–5 job
• Mon/Wed/Fri gym after work
• Sunday: review & plan

scenes.title: Try it yourself
scenes.text: Tell it your constraints, let it ask questions, then ask for the schedule.

demoScript: I asked AI to plan my week and it actually worked. I typed: plan my week, I have a job, the gym three times, and a side project. It asked me one question: when do you have the most energy? I said mornings. Then it gave me a full schedule with deep work in the morning and the gym after work. Try it yourself.
